newsitem.title: USA: SL Industries shareholder may seek control.
newsitem.headline: SL Industries shareholder may seek control.

text.p: A group including UM Investment Corp, a New Jersey-based investor, said Friday that it may opt to seek control of SL Industries Inc.
In a filing with the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission, the 6.4 percent shareholder group said it has not made any definitive plans, but may seek to take control.

The group said in the filing that it does not believe the current SL share price reflects the company's true value. The UM group said it has "studied the feasibility of various strategic approaches" to achieve full shareholder value.

Those strategies include a restructuring of the company involving a spin-off of non-core SL units. "This study included consulting with a bank as to the ability of a third party to finance an acquisition of SL at a premium to current market prices," the investor said in the SEC filing.

The investor group said it would need more information before making any final conclusions. Last month the group said it requested in a letter to the company's board more access to information. The group said SL's board denied that request.
Pending any further actions, the investor said it may purchase additional SL shares.
